Evidence source AUDIT-IR21-OLD-001 | Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear
Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear. Reset printer settings to factory defaults, then clear the pending print jobs and retry printing. Recreate saved printer preferences afterward.
